directionLab.portNote: 8080-8085 were already held by other sessions' labs; 8086 was the first free port. Verified by the served <title>, not by an HTTP 200 - a 200 only proves somebody answered.

selectionEvidence: The owner replied 'D-B' on 2026-08-14, directly to the three-direction comparison table and the hosted lab at http://127.0.0.1:8086.
sharedDecisions: The three bands are coordinate. No band may be styled or sized so that it reads as a subheading of another - that IS the direction.
Membership tiers and Mentor Hub are drawn nowhere. The BRD names both; the API has no query for either. Drawing them would be promising on the backend's behalf.
The installment notice is part of the page, not of a band: it is an obligation rather than knowledge, standing or earnings, and it outranks all three when due.
Every band fetches independently, so one failure cannot blank the page.
